summary: Comprehensive test of Admin PIN lock feature (backend + frontend). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed (wrong PIN→401, correct PIN→200 + session_token, rate-limit 429 after 5+ attempts/min, change-pin missing header→401, full change-pin roundtrip with restore). Frontend: Admin tab hidden from bottom bar (only Shop+Cart visible), 7-tap logo gesture (testID logo-secret-tap) navigates to Admin lock screen, wrong PIN shows 'Incorrect PIN' error, correct PIN 24681357 unlocks the full Admin dashboard, deep-link /admin/settings while locked shows PIN screen (no admin content leaks, guard in app/admin/_layout.tsx works), Change PIN section (current-pin/new-pin/change-pin testIDs) in Store Settings works — changed to 654321 (old fails 401, new works 200) and PIN was RESTORED to 24681357 at the end (verified 200). Regression: menu-button (hamburger) still opens, logo Pressable does NOT block it. No react-native/expo deprecated packages found in this feature's scope. Minor console warning noticed: expo-router logs 'No route named admin/product-form exists in nested children' — pre-existing, unrelated to PIN feature.
action_items: Pre-existing (not blocking): expo-router warning 'No route named admin/product-form exists in nested children' logged on home load. Route resolves at runtime so no user impact, but consider aligning app/admin/_layout.tsx Stack.Screen declarations to silence it.

Font decoding warnings (CormorantGaramond-*.ttf 'invalid sfntVersion: 168430090') seen in browser console — likely font files corrupt/misconfigured for web preview but not blocking this feature; consider investigating separately.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLock error handling uses e?.message from api.verifyAdminPin — verify api.verifyAdminPin surfaces the backend 'Incorrect PIN' / 'Too many attempts…' strings (works in UI test).

admin_sessions and admin_pin_attempts are in-memory dicts; documented in test_credentials.md that backend restart clears them. Consider Redis/DB for horizontally-scaled deployments (not required now).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 9 flows verified: hidden tab, 7-tap gesture, wrong PIN, correct PIN unlock, deep-link guard on /admin/settings, unlocked admin sub-screens open, Change PIN roundtrip, PIN restored to 24681357, menu-button regression)

seed_data_creation: None. PIN was temporarily changed to 654321 during the change-pin UI test then RESTORED to 24681357 via both pytest and browser flows. Final verification: POST /api/admin/verify-pin {pin:'24681357'} → 200.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin PIN lock feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend rate-limit is per-IP 5/min in-memory — if testing gets throttled, wait 60s or restart backend. Frontend hides Admin tab via href:null in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx; secret entry is 7 quick taps (<1.5s apart) on the home logo (testID='logo-secret-tap'). Test credentials at /app/memory/test_credentials.md are current.
